Chapter 6727: Good Sword

Chapter 6727: Good Sword

“That’s hard to say.” Li Qiye shook his head.

“I’m sure you have a full understanding but just haven’t acted on it.” The person said confidently.

“You haven’t caught any clue, why are you so sure of my knowledge?” Li Qiye said.

“Because I’m outside while you are inside. I can’t understand emotions fully or grasp the intricacies. You, on the other hand, have this advantage.” The person said.

Li Qiye sighed and said: “I truly don’t know, he doesn’t either. There’s no need to force it, that’s emotion at work.”

“You treat others with compassion, I’m afraid I wouldn’t do the same.” The person said.

“Because you don’t have the same connection.” Li Qiye said.

“It’s a paradox indeed. Without this connection, I cannot grasp the clue.” The person admitted.

“You can try another way.” Li Qiye smiled.

“Someone has considered this path before, right?” The person asked.

Li Qiye met his gaze and nodded: “Yes, but I said this path should not be taken.”

“If you are this certain, then it must be true. Another path it is.” The person nodded.

“Yes, another.” Li Qiye said.

“Then I can offer you my opinion even though we can’t reveal the details of the future. The key is in Hidden Order. It is the only thing that has a connection with Hidden Immortal.”

“Where is it?” Li Qiye stroked his chin.

“I never cared much about the mortal world since I only want to create, so I do not know.” The person said.

“Alright, leave it to me. If it exists, I will find it.” Li Qiye smiled.

“Hidden Immortal through the order, Octopus through that Heavenly Whale.” The person smiled.

“Octopus is finished because of us, no need to find Heavenly Whale.” Li Qiye said.

“So your top priority is Hidden Immortal.” The person smiled.

“Who is at the top when not counting the high heaven, you, or me?” Li Qiye asked.

“Hidden Immortal.” The person sighed.

“Right, the only existence that can hide from us.” Li Qiye said.

“I must say, I am ashamed that you are doing all the hard work while I watch on the sideline.” The person said.

“It’s fine, I am doing what I must.” Li Qiye said.

“I should be thanking you for saving me some trouble later.” The person said.

“No need to thank me, even if I kill Hidden Immortal, there will be more popping up in the future.” Li Qiye shook his head.

“That’s true.” The person agreed.

“Since you’re taking the mantle later, I’ll deal with Hidden Immortal.” Li Qiye said.

“Good.” The person nodded: “From what I can see, he had let go so you should soon.”

“Just a bit more time.” Li Qiye said.

“A toast for time. We are so close to the end, Sir.” The person raised his cup and laughed.

“Yes, and at the end, it’ll either be you or me.” Li Qiye said.

“Haha, that’s what I like to hear. So be it, either you or me.” The person finished the cup in one gulp.

Li Qiye also did the same.

“We are out of tea.” The person said, staring at the withered primordial flower and empty pot.

“Yes.” Li Qiye said.

“I suppose it is time to go.” The person said.

“Right.” Li Qiye sighed.

“Will you be using this body to fight me?” The person asked.

“It would be disrespectful to do so, I have to keep it.” Li Qiye shook his head.

“I didn’t have as many qualms as you and just let go without thinking twice.” The person said.

“Tossed it right on my tree.” Li Qiye smiled.

“I didn’t think you would mind, it was a good and convenient spot.” The person said.

“Right, it’s not as simple for mine.” Li Qiye said.

“Yes, melting and returning it to the world is far from easy.” The person said.

“Don’t let this stop our fight. I’ll hang it up first and once our battle is over, I’ll return it then. The world can wait.” Li Qiye said.

“Hahaha, Sir, you are so confident.” The person laughed.

“I’m sure you are as well.” Li Qiye said.

“I feel satisfied now that I’ve met you.” The person said.

“I am satisfied with my life as well.” Li Qiye said.

“Please, take your time letting go.” The person bid farewell.

“Wait, I have one more matter.” Li Qiye smiled.

“Oh?” The person didn’t expect this.

“I promised someone.” Li Qiye took out an immortal blade.

“Second’s sword.” The person recognized it and understood: “He still doesn’t accept.”

“After all, it’s a good one.” Li Qiye slowly unsheathed it.

At the halfway point, it let out a terrifying hymn. Calling it the greatest blade in existence was not an exaggeration.

“Indeed.” The person said.

“Can it kill you?” Li Qiye asked.

“Unfortunately, no.” The person shook his head.

“Right, what a shame.” Li Qiye sighed.

“Leave it in the mortal world, don’t break it here by using it against me.” The person said.

“Yes, I will pass it down.” Li Qiye said and sheathed the sword before throwing it.

“Whoosh!” It soared like a meteor through the river of time, eventually pinning the ground before a middle-aged man.

He glanced around with vacant eyes, seemingly unaware of where he was, with two streaks of snot still hanging from his nose.

However, the moment he suddenly saw the immortal sword nailed to the ground in front of his feet, his eyes emitted a divine radiance.

It was as if he had instantly become a completely different person, a sword god. Moreover, sword energy also rose from his body, extending for countless miles.
